decided: 2026-10-14 — owner trade-discovery directive (TC-09 / C4-MTL-03). Component set and weights are declared priors: no relevance-judgement target exists to fit them against yet.
note: RELEVANCE ORDERING ONLY. The score ranks which recorded real trades are most like the package on the calculator; it is never a price, never a value, and never feeds a verdict, a meter or the canonical board. A candidate must share at least one asset with the package (overlap is the gate), so total value can never make two trades 'comparable' on its own (spec TC-09).
unknownFormatNote: Format comparability that cannot be read for the requested league (the ledger's disposition was computed for another league, or none was recorded) scores LOW, never neutral: unknown is not a match. BROAD_CONTEXT is scored the same as unknown, never above it: that disposition covers formats that differ, are unknown, untranslated or timing-limited at the ledger, so it may not outrank 'unknown for this league'.

notIncluded.packageValueProximity: Deferred. Similar value needs each historical trade valued AT THE TIME it happened (Trade History: at-the-time grade = closest snapshot at or before the trade). Today's values would measure how the trade aged, not how similar it is.
notIncluded.pickHorizon: Deferred. 'How far out was the pick then vs now' needs each host league's draft calendar; external leagues do not publish one we hold, and calendar-year distance alone duplicates recency.
notIncluded.assetTierConcentration: Deferred with value proximity: tiers are value bands, so they inherit the same at-the-time requirement.
